title: Pro Mahjong Kiwame-S
overview:
An authentic mahjong game recognized by the pros!

- Enjoy four game modes! Besides regular matches, you can also enjoy challenge matches that span the Japanese archipelago!

16 famous and popular pros who represent Japan take part

プロが認める本格派麻雀ゲーム！

●4モードのゲームが楽しめる！通常の対局にはもちろん、日本列島を股にかけたチャレンジ対局も楽しめる！

日本を代表する有名・人気プロ16名参加
